crossRefs.note: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
crossRefs.keyword: was stedfastly minded. Heb. strengthened herself

crossRefs.note: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
crossRefs.keyword: was stedfastly minded. Heb. strengthened herself

translations.web: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.
translations.bsb: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped trying to persuade her.
translations.kjv: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking
translations.asv: And when she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, she left off speaking unto her.
